rationale: Always-on cost is what stops team-agents becoming a 284-skill catalogue. Every skill description is paid for on every session, whether or not the skill fires. When a change pushes the total over, the fix is a shorter description or disable-model-invocation: true — not raising the ceiling.
counts_toward_budget: skill frontmatter name + description, for every skill without disable-model-invocation
excluded: references/ and scripts/ inside a skill (read on demand)
rules with paths: frontmatter (charged when a matching file is read)
